source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: لما توفت جدتي، ورثنا بيتها القديم.
sentences.en: When my grandmother passed away, we inherited her old house.

sentences.ar: بين أغراضها، لقينا مفتاح حديد قديم.
sentences.en: Among her things, we found an old iron key.
No one knew which door this key belonged to.

sentences.ar: جربناه على كل أبواب البيت، بس ما فتح.
sentences.en: We tried it on every door of the house, but it didn't open any.

sentences.ar: إمي تذكرت إنه جدتي كانت تحكي عن صندوق.
sentences.en: My mom remembered that grandma used to talk about a chest.

sentences.ar: دورنا بالبيت كله لحتى لقينا الصندوق بالعلية.
sentences.en: We searched the whole house until we found the chest in the attic.
We put the key in, it turned, and the chest opened.

sentences.ar: جوا، لقينا صور قديمة ورسائل ودفتر.
sentences.en: Inside, we found old pictures, letters, and a notebook.

sentences.ar: الدفتر كان مذكرات جدتي من أيام شبابها.
sentences.en: The notebook was my grandmother's diary from her youth.

sentences.ar: قعدنا نقرا، وعرفنا قصص ما سمعناها من قبل.
sentences.en: We sat reading, and learned stories we'd never heard before.

sentences.ar: عرفنا كيف تعرفت على جدي، وكيف تجوزوا.
sentences.en: We learned how she met my grandfather, and how they married.

sentences.ar: كل صفحة كانت تحكي عن محبة وصبر.
sentences.en: Every page spoke of love and patience.

sentences.ar: حسينا إنه جدتي رجعت تحكيلنا بصوتها.
sentences.en: We felt that grandma had come back to tell us in her voice.

sentences.ar: من يومها، حطينا الصندوق بمكان أمين.
sentences.en: From that day, we put the chest in a safe place.

sentences.ar: وصار متل الكنز اللي بيربط الأجيال ببعض.
sentences.en: And it became like a treasure that ties the generations together.
